newsitem.title: USA: OPTIONS - FX volatility quiet before G7.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - FX volatility quiet before G7.

text.p: Implied volatility levels for dollar-pair options remained at low levels Tuesday, reflecting a range-bound spot market in a watchful mood ahead of high-level meetings over the next few days.
Options traders said a hush had fallen over the market as participants squared positions in advance of Sunday's meeting of Group of Seven finance ministers and central bankers.
"The market's come to a standstill primarily because they're not really believing anything substantial is going to come out of it," said Alan Revercomb, options strategist for I.D.E.A. Inc.
